translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Kaatiyaa wozanay Med'inaa Godaa kushiyaanna; I Aa wozanaa goggiyaa haatsaa zaariyaawaadan, bare koyeeddasaa zaaree.
Asay ootsiyaawe ubbay izaawoo likke malatee; shin Med'inaa Goday Aa wozanaa k'ofaa paac'c'ee.
Yarshshuwaa yarshshiyaawaappekka aatsiide, s'illobaanne suurebaa ootsiyaawaa Med'inaa Goday dosee.
Iitatuu otorettiyaawaaninne ayyiyaawan erettiino; hewekka nagaraa.
Mino oosanchchaa halchchuu dureyee; shin elleelliyaa ubbay hiyyeessana.
Worddotiide dagayeedda duretay penttuwaa suuluwaadan d'ayee; hewaa koyiyaawanttu hayk'k'uwaa koyiino.
Iitatuu suurebaa ootsanaw is's'iyaa diraw, unttunttu makkala oosuu unttuntta akkiide bee.
Bayzzanchchatuu geella ogiyaan hamettiino; shin geeshshatuu suurebaa ootsiino.
Walak'ettiyaa machchattinna itti golliyaan de'iyaawaappe he golliyaa kashaan de'iyaawe keeka.
Iitatuu iitabaa ootsanaw amottiino; barenttu shoorotoo k'arettikkino.
K'iliic'iyaawe mureteedda wode, wozanay pac'c'eedda uray aad'd'eeda eraa tamaaree; k'ay wozanaama uray tamaariide, eraa demmee.
S'illo S'oossay iitatuwaa son oosettiyaawaa ubbaa be'ee; unttuntta aatsi yeggiide d'ayissee.
Hiyyeesaa waasuwaa sisanaappe giide, bare haytsaa tuc'c'iyaa uray, ikka waassana; alliyaawe d'ayana.
Geeman immiyaa imuu hank'k'uwaa doshissee. Afilaa gidduwaana immeedda mattaayii suulo hank'k'uwaa irs's'issee.
Suure pirdday pirddetteedda wode, hewe s'illoo nashshechchaa; shin iitaa ootsiyaawanttoo dagama.
Akeeka ogiyaappe haddireedda uraa hayk'k'uu naagee.
Aad'o injjiyaan de'ana giyaa uray mank'k'ee; woyniyaa eessaanne zayitiyaa dosiyaa Asay durettenna.
Itti itti gedenne S'oossaa asatuwaa ashshanaw iita asatuu muretiino; ammanettena asatuukka suure asatuwaa diraw muretiino.
Walak'ettiyaanne yilotiyaa machchattinna de'anaappe bazzuwaan de'iyaawe keeka.
Wozanaama uraa son mal"o k'umaynne oyssay minjjettee; shin booza Asay barew de'iyaawaa ubbaa mi diggee.
S'illotetsaanne aggena siik'uwaa koyiyaa uraa laytsay aduk'k'ee; k'ay he uray s'illotetsaanne bonchchuwaa demmee.
Wozanaama Asay wolk'k'aama olanchchatuu de'iyaa katamaa oliide oyk'k'ee; unttunttu ammanetteeda mino geessuwaakka laalee.
Bare doonaanne bare ins's'arssaa naagiyaa Asay barena metuwaappe naagee.
Otorettiyaanne ayyiyaa Asay k'iliic'iyaawaa geetettee; I otoranchcha gideedda diraw, asaw k'oppenna.
Azallaa amuu wod'ee; ayaw gooppe, I ootsanaw koyenna.
Azallay gallassaa kumentsaa darobaa demmanaw amottee; shin s'illuu barew ashshenan immee.
S'oossay iitatuwaa yarshshuwaa shenetee; hewaappekka unttunttu aw iita k'ofaan shiishshiyaa yarshshuwaa aatsi shenetee.
Worddo markkay d'ayana; shin k'oppiide akeekan haasayiyaa uraa haasayay akettana.
Iita Asay tawaa s'alalay likke gee; shin suure Asay yuushshi k'oppee.
Asay bare aad'd'eeda eratetsan, akeekaaninne zoriyaan Med'inaa Godaana ek'ettanaw danddayenna.
Olaw paraa kooranaw danddayettee; shin olaa s'oonissiyaawe Med'inaa Godaa.
